hypotheses.claim: A deterministic semantic transition kernel plus sealed receipts for every semantically relevant nondeterministic input can reproduce exact post-state across replay while allowing the physical runtime itself to remain nondeterministic.
hypotheses.falsifier: A controlled H1/H2 trace with identical pre-state, intervention and complete receipt bundle yields unexplained authoritative semantic divergence.

hypotheses.claim: Semantic identity and execution-trace identity must be separate: retry counts, latency and worker identity should not cause semantic mismatch unless the contract explicitly makes them program-observable.
hypotheses.falsifier: An execution-only field excluded from semantic identity changes an authoritative state/result under the frozen contract.

hypotheses.claim: Across a crash after an external non-idempotent effect may have committed but before durable local outcome recording, a local runtime without remote deduplication/status query cannot guarantee exactly-once by retry-or-skip alone; it needs a query/dedupe protocol or an explicit COMMIT_UNKNOWN reconciliation state.
hypotheses.falsifier: A protocol using no external idempotency, no remote status query and no stronger transactional coupling guarantees exactly one externally visible effect in both indistinguishable local post-crash worlds.

hypotheses.claim: Deterministic replay/simulation and real multithreaded race testing are complementary rather than substitutes.
hypotheses.falsifier: Target-runtime evidence shows all concurrency semantics are fully represented by the deterministic scheduler model and real concurrency adds no distinct failure surface.

hypotheses.claim: A receipt-closure matrix can become a reusable H1-to-H2 differential oracle spanning GWT, peer/tool calls, capability observations, visual inputs, effect outcomes and recovery without requiring every execution detail in the semantic hash.
hypotheses.falsifier: Receipt capture overhead or unresolved hidden nondeterminism makes exact differential replay impractical on the Ubuntu target, or semantic equivalence cannot be defined without including unstable execution metadata.

counterhypotheses.claim: The runtime should instead force a single deterministic scheduler globally; receipts are unnecessary complexity.
counterhypotheses.discriminator: Compare utility/latency/concurrency coverage and real race detection against selective receipt sealing.

counterhypotheses.claim: A full byte-identical trace hash is the safest H1/H2 oracle.
counterhypotheses.discriminator: Vary retry/latency/worker metadata while holding semantic state/outcomes fixed; measure false divergence.

counterhypotheses.claim: Effect retries alone can provide exactly-once recovery.
counterhypotheses.discriminator: Crash after remote apply and before local durable outcome with a non-idempotent, non-queryable adapter.

counterhypotheses.claim: Successful deterministic replay establishes causal validity of a GWT/emergence mechanism.
counterhypotheses.discriminator: Matched lesion/shuffle/rescue intervention can fail even when baseline replay is perfect; causal promotion therefore remains separate.
